issues.title: Original 9-5 front caliper bolt dangerously misprinted as rotor-screw torque in replacement prose
issues.cause: 2008 rotor removal/refit page states 4 Nm both for rotor lock screw and caliper retaining fastener; 2008 dedicated brake joint table specifies 140 Nm+45° for front caliper and 4 Nm only for small rotor screw.
symptoms: service page or aftermarket guide quotes 4 Nm front caliper carrier bolts
replacement procedure and separate technical table disagree
issues.diagnosis_summary: Stop torque service if the joint cannot be positively identified. Match physical fastener and manufacturer torque table, review safety-critical discrepancy with knowledgeable specialist and original source before fastening.
issues.correction_summary: Database blocks promoting 4 Nm as a front caliper carrier bolt torque. Preserve both readings with explicit cross-source conflict until authoritative revision confirms procedure.
limits: No assumption that any vehicle was actually incorrectly torqued.
Only MY2008 original 9-5 procedure independently sourced.
4 Nm is the actual small rotor screw specification; never label both joints the same.

issues.title: 9-5 rotor configuration matrix versus individual year technical details disagree
issues.cause: 9-5 MY2009 brake-configuration chart lists B1 front 288x25 and B2 308x25; MY2006 front rotor technical page lists standard 285x25 and heavily laden 308x28, and heavy min 22 despite new 28.
symptoms: two factory pages give different rotor diameter or new thickness
seller/parts listing assumes any 9-5 Aero rotor fits based on badge
issues.diagnosis_summary: Inspect actual hub rotor diameter/thickness and installed caliper carrier, identify original B1/B2/B3 configuration and year/market/engine using Saab EPC before ordering; preserve original source conflict.
issues.correction_summary: No OEM approval from dimensions or generalized trim alone. Obtain Saab part-build record/revision or in situ documented compatibility before safety-critical parts purchase.
limits: 2006 and 2009 figures are not demonstrated interchangeable or necessarily for identical original options.
No original Saab EPC VIN-specific brake part ID accessed.
Do not silently choose or average conflicting safety-critical numbers.

issues.title: NG9-3 brake level and caliper carrier are an assembly, not a rotor-only swap
issues.cause: MY2006 level 1–4 rotor sizes and caliper piston types are paired with VIN plate positions 7–10 and multiple different pads and holders; parts vary even within the same market/year.
symptoms: shopping for rotors or calipers without VIN plate option row
larger rotor kit proposed without matching carrier and wheel clearance evidence
issues.diagnosis_summary: Photograph bottom VIN option row 7–10, compare front/rear rotor diameter, thickness, rear venting, caliper type FNG/FNRG/FNC and holder, with actual vehicle condition; check wheel and brake pipe routing.
issues.correction_summary: Replace only proven level-compatible original hardware, manufacturer-approved kit or professionally engineered solution; document all dependencies before fitment.
limits: Source does not include current OEM part numbers or approved cross-level upgrades.
Painted calipers or an Aero badge aren't sufficient classification.
VIN options may not represent swapped hardware.

issues.title: OG9-5 rear parking shoes differ from 9-3 integrated rear caliper and hydraulic hose safety
issues.cause: OG9-5 has independent parking shoes/adjuster accessed via rear discs, NG9-3 handbrake lever operates rear hydraulic caliper pad/piston; hydraulic lines need clear supported routing and bleeding after opening.
symptoms: handbrake adjustment or rear caliper part selected from wrong Saab family
unconfirmed leak or unresolved pedal after line work
issues.diagnosis_summary: Identify platform and exact rear brake type, verify mechanical parking action and hose routing from factory source, assess rusted line support/condition and wheel travel.
issues.correction_summary: Follow exact system procedure, bleed/inspect hydraulic integrity after opening, and test service plus parking brakes only when vehicle is safe to road-test.
limits: No generic 9-3 parking shoe kit can be transferred to OG9-5.
A brake pedal feel observation cannot certify hydraulic safety.
